title: CV-tweaker
description: Development of a CV-tweaking app using Rust (Tauri), a React JS frontend and ollama embedding model nomic-embed-text

title: Timeshift TUI (Rust)
description: Development of a terminal UI for Timeshift to manage snapshots more easily than the CLI. Written in Rust with Ratatui, designed for headless environments.

title: VM Hypervisor Orchestrator
description: Development of a virtual machine hypervisor orchestrator using libvirt for virtualization management, a Flask backend API, and a React frontend to control and monitor VMs.

title: Proxmox Security Lab Infrastructure
description: Design and deployment of a company-scale network security lab based on a Proxmox cluster hosting multiple virtual machines to simulate cyber attacks and defense scenarios. Automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Ansible.

title: Samba Domain Controller & Automated Deployment
description: Deployment and administration of a Samba server acting as a Windows domain controller, including automated software and application deployment using WPKG in an enterprise-like environment.

title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Setup
description: Setup and configuration of a Security Operations Center using Prelude SIEM, Prewikka for event visualization, and OSSEC for host-based intrusion detection, along with penetration testing using Hydra to validate detection and response capabilities.

title: Proxmox Infrastructure Automation (Terraform & Ansible)
description: Design and implementation of an automated and scalable infrastructure for deploying virtual machines on Proxmox using Terraform, followed by post-deployment configuration of services with Ansible. The project includes cloud-init VM templating, modular roles, and fully reproducible Infrastructure-as-Code workflows.

title: Multiplayer Evolutionary Game of Life (Peer-to-Peer)
description: Development of a multiplayer evolutionary Game of Life in Python using Pygame, featuring autonomous entities ('slimes') and a custom peer-to-peer broadcast network protocol without central server. Implementation of a structured message protocol for movement, interaction, combat, synchronization, and dynamic ownership of game objects.
